name: Haoran
source:
An honest and gentle-mannered young man who's working at a restaurant. Every since they were younger, Haoran and our protagonist would go to and fro from places together.

He's like an older brother to her.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/otomedaoshi/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
